location_exception_reason: Guest house location is a primary buyer decision factor — guests explicitly search by destination (Goa, Rajasthan, Delhi-NCR, hill stations, pilgrimage towns). Removing location from the title makes the listing unsearchable and meaningless to the buyer.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (e.g. 'Operator', 'Manager', 'Proprietor') describe the seller role, not the product. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes business classification independently; the product remains 'guest house accommodation' regardless of who operates it.
